entries.zh: 堵、塞住（塞：堵住洞孔）
entries.en: to stop up, plug (holes)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [damaged original; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语栏两处残缺、音写栏声调记号污损（T99），汉字「感」虽清晰但与残缺西语无从互证，语义不能定夺

entries.zh: 盖住、覆掩（翕）〔西语栏词义不明，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to cover over [Spanish term uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语「resgallo」不见于通行旧辞书，疑为 rescoldo（火种余烬）之转写，仅存疑备释

entries.zh: 障蔽、遮障（障）；以帷毯遮盖墙面（entapizar）
entries.en: to screen off, cover with hangings; to wainscot (entapizar)
entries.notes: 音写栏声调记号污损（T99），汉字栏仅「障」清晰，另两音节对应字不可辨

entries.zh: 杜塞、堵塞（杜；杜塞洞孔）
entries.en: to stop up, block (holes)
entries.notes: 音写「tou chai」两音节而汉字栏仅「杜」，第二字不可辨（T99 污损）；依杜塞义与西语互证

entries.zh: 关闭、闩闭（閈塞：关门上闩）；堵塞
entries.en: to close (cerrar), shut (the door); to bar, stop up
entries.notes: 「cexar」按 17 世纪拼写展开为 cerrar；「閈/閂」存疑取门闩义，「24」疑为版面编号或误读

entries.zh: 整好装进、嵌合到位（整落去）
entries.en: to stop up by fitting into place (encajar)
entries.notes: 「cajando」依汉字「整落去」（嵌装到位）定为 encajando（嵌入装合），非 cayando（默然）

entries.zh: 糊泥封补（墙上的洞）；糊土
entries.en: to plaster with mud (holes in a wall)
entries.notes: 音写栏声调记号污损（T99）；词义本身四栏尚可互证（糊土＝泥封墙洞）

entries.zh: 牵被盖身（拉过绣被覆盖）
entries.en: to pull the quilt over, cover (oneself) with the bedspread

entries.zh: 闩上系紧（閂帶：既闭又闩扣）
entries.en: shut (tapado) and barred, fastened with a band
entries.notes: 「pueth/puens」存疑，依汉字「閂帶」取闩闭扣系义

entries.zh: 塞住、堵住（塞帶）
entries.en: to stop up, plug

entries.zh: 塞紧、塞密（塞密）
entries.en: to stop up tight, seal well

entries.zh: 遮蔽、遮住（不使人看见）
entries.en: to cover, screen (so as not to be seen); to conceal

entries.zh: 遮拦、遮护（遮欄：遮蔽以作屏障庇护）
entries.en: to screen, shelter, protect by covering

entries.zh: 盖上、罩下去（翕落去）
entries.en: to cover over, put the cover down

entries.zh: 盖火焖炭（以灰土盖火制炭）〔原件污损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to bank up the fire (cover it) so as to make charcoal
entries.notes: 音写栏声调记号污损（T99）且「im/in」存疑；依汉字「蓋炭」与西语盖火制炭互证

entries.zh: 螺口（蜗牛壳之口）〔字残难辨，释义存疑〕
entries.en: the mouth (aperture) of a snail shell
entries.notes: 汉字「痞/疵」与音写「te/le」均存疑且声调记号污损（T99）；依西语「la boca del caracol」与「螺」取螺壳口义

entries.zh: 墙（夯土墙）
entries.en: rammed-earth wall (tapia); wall

entries.zh: 墙壁
entries.en: wall (tapia or pared)

entries.zh: 三合土（灰、砂、土拌和的夯筑土料，即 tapia）
entries.en: rammed earth (lime-sand-clay mixture used for rammed-earth walls)
entries.notes: 音写栏声调记号污损（T99）；三合土与 tapia（夯土）对当清晰

entries.zh: 舂捣、夯筑（舂：夯打筑土）
entries.en: to ram, tamp (earth) in building
entries.notes: 汉字栏录作「春」，按 tapiar（夯筑）义当为「舂」（捣、夯）之形近字

entries.zh: 夯壁、舂土筑壁（动词：夯筑墙壁）
entries.en: to ram (earth) into a wall; to build walls by tamping
entries.notes: 「t.」为动词略号；汉字「春」同上条当为「舂」之形近读
